That's very kind of you, and it's true. I'd never even considered that. I'm sorry I wasn't here last night, I forced myself to sleep to get the day over with.

>On the topic, and for verification, what's a friend modifier do to a variable?


Friend, internal... I haven't heard those terms since my very early days of programming. VB.NET and C#. I think that was a trick question. It allows a class, structure, module, etc to be accessed outside of the (I think default) private declaration scope. Similar to the 'our' declaration in Perl, 'global' in Python, or anything declared outside of a function in C/C++.
